info.title: Macroma public API
info.description: Read and change Macroma workspaces, projects and tasks from your own tools. Authenticate with a personal access token as a Bearer token; a `read` token may only use GET.

get.description: The workspaces the token's account belongs to, newest first.
Ordered by `updated_at`, then `id`, oldest first, so `updated_since` and `cursor` sync changes incrementally. Deleted tasks are listed by `GET /projects/{id}/tasks/deleted`.

post.description: Goes to the backlog of the given batch, or of the active batch when `batch_id` is left out. Members of the project see it live.

get.description: The task with its project, batch, creator and every version it went through.

patch.description: Send the `revision` you last read. When the task changed since, the answer is 409 `STALE_REVISION` with the task as it is now in `current`: merge, then retry with its revision.

delete.description: Only the project owner may delete a task. Its comments, history and images go with it.

get.description: Oldest first, as a conversation reads.

patch.summary: Move a task to another column
patch.description: Records a new version of the task and notifies its assignee and creator, as a move on the board does. Moving to `revisi` needs a `note`.

bearerAuth.description: A personal access token (`mcr_…`), created while signed in to Macroma.
